coverage.summary: Retained both useful existing examples and added a two-digit entry example, giving two-, three- and four-digit coverage of one assessed method. Checked example arithmetic, source alignment, gutters and diagram annotations. Diagrams remain editable, unshaded and black with authored 10 pt labels. Practice and quiz were read only to classify methods; their mathematics was neither changed nor re-audited. Actual rendering and final-size typography verification remain for the later visual stage. No files were written.

examples.derivation: 200×4=800, 60×4=240 and 7×4=28; 800+240+28=1068. The supplementary check gives 260×4=1040 and 1040+28=1068. Question partitions and solution rectangle annotations agree.
1406=1000+400+0+6. Multiplication by 7 gives 7000, 2800, 0 and 42; their sum is 9842. Omitting the zero tens rectangle preserves the calculation. All solution rectangle annotations agree.
47=40+7; 40×5=200 and 7×5=35, so 47×5=235. The question shows only givens; the solution adds the correct part-products.

review.summary: Confirmed one distinct assessed method: place-value partitioning, multiplying each part by a one-digit factor, then adding the area-model part-products. All 22 exact assessment locators map to it. The supplied numerical investigation supports this method; three- and four-digit applications remain within the governing Stage 3 scope. Both existing examples preserve their mathematics and useful supplementary content. Continuation calculations have phantom equals gutters; independent equations do not. Solution prose remains editable and inherits blue styling, while diagrams retain black ink and solution-only derived annotations. Source images and supplied text support the mapping. Final-size rendering and label verification remain for the visual stage. Accepted assessment mathematics was not re-audited.
